terra.problem: Paul says the woman is joined to another man while her husband lives; he does not call the other man her new husband.
The claim about Moses and the law is outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say Abraham was not raised from the dead. Paul identifies the risen Christ without making that claim about Abraham.
The claims that the believers lived in Rome and that Rome was the letter's address are outside this passage and need a reference.
The claim that the world has blame elsewhere in Scripture is outside this passage and has no reference.
Papa refers to being taken out of the dark but does not identify the drawer, leaving his backstory reference unclear to a new baker.
Saying Paul heard how the preceding verses sounded and stopped for that reason adds an unmarked thought and reason not given in the text.
Saying Paul picked coveting out of a list introduces a list the passage does not give.
The statement that lying is a sin is a Bible fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
